external_games.name: Water Drop Brick Breaker - Orange Skin Pack

name: Water Drop Brick Breaker: Orange Skin Pack
summary: This DLC includes 1 set of orange-themed skins: 1 water drop skin and 1 paddle skin. After purchase, equip the skins in the main menu → "My Skins". The water drop skin changes the ball appearance; the paddle skin changes the paddle appearance.
